howToApply: Visit the ESIC official website www.esic.gov.in/recruitments between 1st to 7th of every month to check vacancy details.
Fill the application form in BLOCK letters using black/blue ink as per the prescribed format.
Prepare a Demand Draft (if applicable) of Rs. 500/- in favour of ‘ESI Fund A/c No.-1’, payable at Indore.
Scan the completed application form, Demand Draft, and all required/supporting self-attested documents (including research publications and conference papers, if any) into a single compiled PDF file.
Send the single PDF file via email to dean-indore.mp@esic.gov.in latest by 04:00 PM of 15th of every month. Write your Name, Post, and Department in the email subject line.

Send the original application form with self-attested supporting documents and original Demand Draft (if applicable) by post/courier to: The Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Nanda Nagar, Indore (M.P.) – 452011, to reach on or before 17th of every month.
Write on the envelope: ‘Recruitment of Teaching Faculty/Senior Residents on contract basis’ with Name of Post and Department.
Report for the Walk-in Interview on 18th of every month (or the next working day if 18th is a holiday) at 09:00 AM. No candidate will be allowed after 9:00 AM.
Bring original documents for verification before the interview.

A walk-in-interview will be conducted for the month of November-2026 on the 18/11/2026 (Reporting Time : 09:00 AM. No candidate will be allowed after 9:00AM) and subsequently on 18th of every month. If the 18th happens to be a holiday, the interview will instead be held on the immediately following next date or as notified from time to time.
